pages.title: Jaipur Rugs Return, Exchange & Warranty Policy
pages.text:
RETURN & EXCHANGE POLICY (India customers):
- Customers may request a return or exchange within 14-15 days of receiving their order (14 days hassle-free return for India per official FAQ; policy page states up to 15 days).
- Returns and exchanges apply only to non-custom, non-discounted items.
- Discounted inventory: no returns or exchanges (online and offline).
- Customer must share an image of the packed product to initiate a return request.
- All returns subject to quality inspection before approval.
- No restocking fee for returns or exchanges.
- Exchanges processed only after returned product passes Quality Control.
- Exchange for equal or higher value product (pay difference). Exchanges for lower value not eligible for partial refunds.
- Exchange value rule: exchanges allowed only for items of equal or higher value.
- Free return shipping for exchanges/refunds within India only.
- Custom orders: exchange only for manufacturing defect.
- Items delivered outside India are not eligible for return and refund (India-only return window). International customers: Warranty Policy applies.

REFUNDS:
- Refunds for cancelled orders typically within 7-10 business days to original payment source.
- International refunds may take 7-21 business days via original payment method (card, PayPal) or store credit — not bank transfer for international.
- Foreign transaction fees are customer responsibility.

CANCELLATION:
- Order may be cancelled before shipment — contact shop@jaipurrugs.com or +91 7412060022 / order-update@jaipurrugs.com / +91 7665017083.
- Cancellation within 24 hours of placement if not yet shipped; once shipped, use return process.
- Custom and made-to-order rugs cannot be cancelled once confirmed.
- Jaipur Rugs may cancel orders for pricing errors, stock issues, fraud, or policy non-compliance.

REFUND PAYMENT NOTES:
- Refunds to UPI/wallet/bank transfer may require bank details per order type — contact customer service.
- GST-compliant invoice provided for domestic orders; provide GSTIN at checkout for ITC.
- Digital invoice emailed on shipment.

GIFT CARDS:
- Digital gift cards valid 12 months from issue.
- Store credits from refunds cannot be converted to cash.

WARRANTY:
- Rugs come with 6 to 24-month warranty depending on product.
- Warranty excludes normal wear, shedding, sun fading, moisture damage, heavy furniture damage.

CONTACTS:
- General: shop@jaipurrugs.com | +91 8000295928
- Order tracking/after-sales: order-update@jaipurrugs.com | +91 7665017083
- Rug care/repair: rugcare@jaipurrugs.com | +91 9039195506

pages.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
pages.text:
SHIPPING CHARGES:
- Free shipping on items purchased through the Jaipur Rugs website (free shipping globally per FAQ; oversized rugs may incur extra cost shown at checkout).

DELIVERY TIME:
- Orders dispatched within 48 business hours.
- Estimated delivery: next day up to 10 business days from order — varies by product; check product detail page and enter delivery pin code for estimate.
- During sales, delivery may delay 5-7 days.
- Custom rugs lead time typically 6-12 weeks depending on design and materials.

ORDER CONFIRMATION:
- Email order confirmation and SMS/text confirmation sent after successful order.
- Shipping email with tracking and invoice sent when product ships.

TRACKING:
- Tracking link via email/SMS once shipped; track on website Order Tracking Portal.
- For order status: order-update@jaipurrugs.com | +91 7665017083 or shop@jaipurrugs.com | +91 7412060022.

CANCELLATION BEFORE SHIP:
- Cancel before dispatch via shop@jaipurrugs.com or +91 7412060022; refund within 48 business hours to original payment mode if cancelled before shipment.

INTERNATIONAL:
- Extra duties and local taxes may apply per destination customs laws — paid to shipping partner at delivery unless otherwise stated.
- Jaipur Rugs may cover import duties/customs for international customers per return-policy page — verify at checkout.

DAMAGED IN TRANSIT:
- Contact customer service immediately with photos; assistance with return, replacement, or refund.

TIER 2/3 CITIES:
- Delivery available across India where courier network serves; enter pin code on product page for estimate.

pages.title: Jaipur Rugs Frequently Asked Questions
pages.text:
ORDERS & TRACKING:
- Where is my order? Contact +91 7412060022, shop@jaipurrugs.com, or website chat 09:30 AM-06:30 PM IST. Order tracking: order-update@jaipurrugs.com | +91 7665017083.
- Delivered but not received: contact after-sales team immediately with order number.
- Change delivery address: contact customer service before shipment with order number — order-update@jaipurrugs.com.
- Payment failed but money deducted: contact customer service with payment reference; refund processed if duplicate charge.

PAYMENT (official FAQ — authoritative for what customers can pay with at checkout):
- Accepted payment methods per official Jaipur Rugs FAQ: credit/debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express) and PayPal.
- Financing/installments: Snapmint available at checkout.
- UPI, net banking, COD, and wallets (GPay/PhonePe/Paytm) are NOT listed on the official FAQ as accepted checkout methods. Do NOT tell customers UPI or COD is accepted unless Jaipur Rugs updates the FAQ.
- If a customer asks about UPI, COD, or net banking: say these are not listed on the official FAQ payment page; for confirmation contact shop@jaipurrugs.com or +91 8000295928.
- No hidden fees; taxes/shipping shown at checkout.
- Cannot change payment method after order placed — cancel and reorder if needed.
- Receipt/invoice emailed on confirmation; downloadable from account.

CANCELLATION:
- Cancel within 24 hours of placement before processing/shipping via customer service with order number.
- Partial order cancellation possible — specify rugs to cancel.
- Refund for cancelled order: 7-10 business days.

RETURNS & EXCHANGES:
- India: return/exchange within 14 days for non-custom, non-discounted items.
- Outside India: not eligible for return/refund; exchange conditions may apply within 15 days per international FAQ.
- Custom rugs: non-refundable unless manufacturing defect.
- Rug looks different from website photo or defect/damage: contact customer service with photos immediately.

CUSTOM & BESPOKE:
- Custom rugs available — email shop@jaipurrugs.com or call +91 7665017083, or use custom size on product page.
- Bespoke rugs: personalised design, colour, material, size — contact shop@jaipurrugs.com or +91 7665017083.
- Lead time 6-12 weeks for custom.
- Minimum order for custom: contact shop@jaipurrugs.com or +91 7665017083.

B2B / BULK / TRADE:
- Bulk, hotel, interior designer, wholesale inquiries: shop@jaipurrugs.com — team will assist.
- White-label/private label: contact shop@jaipurrugs.com for B2B discussion.
- Export and lead times: contact shop@jaipurrugs.com.

GIFTING:
- Gift cards available (digital, 12-month validity per return policy page).
- Gift wrap and personalised message on orders: contact shop@jaipurrugs.com to confirm availability for your order.

RUG CARE:
- Vacuum weekly; blot spills, do not rub; professional cleaning recommended; do not immerse hand-knotted/silk rugs in water.
- Rotate every 3-6 months; protect from direct sunlight.
- Shedding on new wool rugs can be normal — contact rugcare@jaipurrugs.com for assessment.

RUG PADS / ANTI-SLIP:
- Jaipur Rugs sells custom anti-slip mats/rug pads cut to rug dimensions.
- Use rug pad to prevent slipping — see https://www.jaipurrugs.com/in/know-your-rug/about-rug-pads

PRODUCT INFO:
- Hand-knotted: individual knots tied by hand — dense, durable, traditional, higher price.
- Hand-tufted: yarn punched into backing with tufting gun — faster to make, generally less durable than hand-knotted.
- High-traffic: choose durable constructions; stain-resistant coating available at order.
- Pet-friendly: wool is durable and naturally stain-resistant; contact team for material advice.
- Dyes/kids safety: contact shop@jaipurrugs.com for specific product certifications.
- Sunlight fading: rugs can fade in direct sun — use window treatments and rotate.

MARKETPLACE:
- Purchase directly from jaipurrugs.com for full selection, custom options, and official support.

STORES:
- Multiple showrooms in India and internationally — see Contact Us page or ask for store locations.

pages.title: Anti-Slip Mats and Rug Pads
pages.text:
Jaipur Rugs sells custom anti-slip mats (rug pads) tailored to your rug size.

Benefits: floor protection, slip resistance, impact absorption, prolonged rug lifespan, noise reduction, comfort underfoot.

Rug pads prevent rugs from slipping, protect floors from scratches, provide cushioning, promote air circulation, and make cleaning easier.

Choose a pad matching rug size and shape; can be trimmed slightly smaller than rug for non-slip pads.

Rug pads do not stick permanently to floor — placed beneath rug and removable.

Do not stitch rug pad to carpet.

Cleaning: vacuum both sides; some pads machine washable on gentle cycle.

Pricing: custom anti-slip mats from approximately INR 100+GST (18%) per sq. ft. — confirm exact price for your size via shop@jaipurrugs.com or +91 8000295928.

Purchase help: shop@jaipurrugs.com | +91 8000295928 (WhatsApp).

More info: https://www.jaipurrugs.com/in/know-your-rug/about-rug-pads
